hypotheses.R1_fisher_error_decreases_with_rank: Opposite-half Fisher error is nonincreasing across the locked rank sweep, allowing 2% numerical tolerance.
hypotheses.R2_rank16_reaches_median_kl_gate: Continuous rank 16 has median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_rank16_improves_rank8_mean_kl: Rank 16 reduces mean exact KL by at least 20% relative to rank 8 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_rank16_preserves_task_ce: Rank 16 increases mean next-token CE by at most 0.01 nats on every corpus.
hypotheses.R5_rank32_is_high_fidelity: Rank 32 has median exact KL at most 0.002 and top-1 agreement at least 0.97 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R6_smallest_universal_gate_is_at_most_16: The smallest tested rank reaching median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus is no greater than 16.
